question: ________ is known as Golden Fiber.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jute.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jute **is known as **Golden Fiber.**
 
• Jute is a** long, soft, shiny vegetable fiber** that can be spun into coarse, strong threads.
 
• It is primarily grown in** India, Bangladesh, and China.**
 
• Jute is commonly used for making** burlap, sacks, and twine.**
 
• Jute is also eco-friendly as it is a** renewable resource** and **biodegradable.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Corn** is a **cereal crop** that is primarily used for **food and animal feed.**
 
• **Cotton** is a** soft, fluffy fiber** that grows in a protective case around the seeds of the cotton plant.
 
 
• It is primarily grown in the **United States, India, and China.**
 
• Cotton is commonly used for making** clothing and textiles.**
 
 
 
• **Synthetic thread** is **not** a natural fiber like jute, cotton, and corn.
 
 
• It is made from **chemicals** and is commonly used for making** clothing, upholstery, and other textiles.**
